title: Inefficient Razor that's Rough to Use: There are much better value bargain razors out there.
text:
The Acevivi Razor : A Test and Review
I only came across this razor very recently. It intrigued me because some seemed to like it and report that it was well made. Also, like the new Fendrihan razors, it has an unusual head: Closed comb on one side; open comb on the other. I think the idea is that it offers two levels of aggression. The Lutz slant offers a similar choice of two levels of aggression.

In use I found that both sides offered about the same level of aggression. Another reason for the test is that it's a low cost razor; under $13 currently on Amazon. I'm always intrigued by potential bargains!

A further unusual feature is the exceptionally long handle. Longer than the Futur, longer than my Mergress, Schick Krona, or even my long handled Gillette Starburst, (aimed at the ladies” market); longer in fact than any razor I own. To some this is a plus, to others not so. It may be useful if ladies wish to use the razor on their legs, or other parts. The razor is well balanced so the long handle presented no problem.

The razor comes with a box of five blades. I have no idea of their origin. But since the razor is Chinese, I expect China.

The Blade used for the Test
I chose to use the Rapira Platinum Lux. I've found this blade to be consistent and reliable in just about every razor (but there are some razors where it's an indifferent pairing, say with my RR Wunderbar), and it's always good for at least four shaves, often six, in just about any razor. It's sharp, smooth, comfortable, very cheap to buy, and easily available, and my personal favorite of the Rapira line. I've also used it every DE razor I own at one time or another, and I own over 50 DE safety razors . Not my favorite blade, but a very good one in most razors. I used a brand new blade

How I Used this Razor for the Test
When using an adjustable razor, (and following advice from others on this forum, including Jim Chandler, plus my own long experimentation) I've found the best way, for the smoothest and most comfortable shave is to INCREASE the aggression with each pass. It seems counter-intuitive at first but it really works best. It's like lowering the blade on a lawn mower to get a closer cut. I increased the aggression on each pass on this test.

Since this razor supposedly offered two choices of aggression I used the Acevivi in this way: Less aggressive WTG and XTG, then more aggressive ATG and for buffing. I'm assuming that closed comb is less aggressive, though as some have reported with the Fendrihan, this is not always the case.

Now in previous reviews, I notice that some people seem to miss this point. I really believe that this is the best way to get a very smooth, comfortable, and importantly irritation-free shave with an adjustable razor. I have a complete thread on this method. Please review the thread and give it a whirl, and report what you find please!

The Routine
For testing I go through the same routine. I clean my face and wet the beard by washing with a glycerin soap. I rinse off the soap, wet it thoroughly and apply two drops of a pre-shave oil.

By the way, I believe good pre-shave prep not only produces a better shave, but reduces irritation, and keeps you skin in good condition. I know of one rather famous reviewer whose skin frankly looks irritated, red, blotchy and awful, especially on his neck. I don't doubt he gets close shaves, but at what cost?

I use an Arko shave stick applied directly to the beard and lather with a Stirling Synthetic “Kong” brush. I rinse and lather again between passes. I thoroughly rinse the head of the razor between passes.

I remove the blade from the razor when I'm done. I dry it with a microfiber cloth. Naturally I dry the razor too when I'm done.

I finish with an Alum block, which is a good indicator of razor burn or irritation. Then after washing it off , I apply Thayer's Alcohol Free Witch Hazel.

The Shave
I shaved 22 hours before doing a test comparison of the Parker Variant and Ming Shi 2000s, so my face had a little less than average growth.

First Pass WTG: Closed Comb Side
Fairly smooth, reasonably efficient. Not good enough for a one pass shave.

Second Pass XTG: Closed Com Side
Not especially smooth and after the pass I wasn't especially happy with the hair removal. It still felt like there was a lot of hair, but I press on! Still not good enough even for everyday.

Third Pass ATG: Open Comb Side
Quite scratchy. I could feel the blade and I didn't enjoy the pass much. A lost of hair remained. Quite disappointing. Not a good shave at all.

Buff up and J-hooking
I would have had to spend an age buffing and cleaning up because the beard was still quite rough, and frankly my face already felt quite irritated. So I did not buff with the Acevivi. There are limits to my testing zeal!

Finishing the Shave:
Sometimes a specific blade is no good. In the interests of fairness, I took the blade out and put it in my most efficient razor, the RR Wunderbar slant (which incidentally is not a blade this razor likes a lot) and had to shave again, because the shave with the Acevivi was just not good enough even for everyday.

I then did another ATG pass, and boy, was there a lot to remove! The jawline and neck still had a lot of growth. The blade performed well in the Wunderbar, so I don't think one can't blame the blade.

Now I'm not comparing a $13 razor to a $130. That would be grossly unfair. I just wanted to see if the blade was to blame, and frankly I didn't want to irritate my face more than necessary.

I did a clean up and buffing pass, using the Wunderbar and got a BBS shave. However the feedback from alum block revealed a lot of irritation, not surprising given three indifferent and inefficient passes with the Acevivi, followed by another ATG pass and cleanup with the Wunderbar, though I don't blame the latter. No nicks, cuts, or weepers, but definite neck irritation.

Conclusion:
The razor is well made, and low in price, and I admire the innovation, but I cannot recommend the Acevivi, unless you want to get a very long handle that's well made for under $13. It's possible that it will do better with other blades, but my initial impression is that it's not really worth testing. It's a fairly mild and quite inefficient razor.

Is it good value? No! The Ming Shi 2000s Adjustable is cheaper (aroud $10 from China) and better in every possible way. The following razors, all under $20 are much, much better: The RazoRock (RR) German 37 Slant, the Phoenix Artisan Accoutrements Bakelite slant, the RR Slab, the RR Mission, the RR Old Type, the RR Jaws (if you can get it), and probably some others too.

It's a pretty poor razor, and even at the low price not worth it. I wouldn't recommend it to newbies, because it will put them off DE shaving. Here's one to pass.

title: Great Blade. Much Cheaper Elsewhere.
text:
Rapira Platinum Lux:
Great Value, and a Superior and Consistent Performer. But much cheaper to buy in bulk elsewhere.

I have been and am continuing to perform a series of tests testing one blade against another,i n a variety of razors. I want to report that the Rapira Platinum Lux is consistently excellent, out performing or at the least equaling every blade I've tested it against, regardless of razor. I've tested it against, Posilver Super Iridium, Voskhod, Rapira Super Stainless, (blue and pink wrapper) Rapira Swedish Supersteel, Croma Diamant, Baili, and Super Max,

I have a coarse, fairly heavy, and fast growing beard, and I tend to prefer more aggressive razors. I have found the Rapira Platinum Lux to work excellently in every type of razor I've put it in. It is sharp, very smooth and comfortable, and produces excellent shaves for four shaves at least. The fourth shave sometimes, but not always exhibits a slight drop in performance.

Here are the razors I've tested this blade in: Parker 26c Open Comb, Merkur Futur, Merkur Mergress (modified Progress), FaTip Grande, Gillete Slim, Gillette TTO Red Tip, Schone Italian, Gillette Open Comb New Style, Schick Krona TTO, Pearl TTO (an aggressive razor) Hofritz Travel Razor, Merkur 37C slant bar, Ikon Shavecraft 102 slant bar, and Lutz slant bar.

Aggressive, or mild, one piece TTO, two piece or three piece, expensive or cheap, open comb, closed comb, or slant bar, this blade is smooth, comfortable, sharp, consistent and long lasting in every razor. I cannot say this of any other blade I have tested so far. Other blades perform worse, or only perform excellently paired with specific razors and not so in other.

Of course, there are many blades I haven't tested but these are usually reported as mediocre by others (eg. Derby, Lord, Shark) or much more expensive such as, Feather, Kai, and some of the Gillette and Wilkinson Sword blades. The Rapira is both excellent and very reasonable in price. It also outperforms other Rapira blades in my testing, at least.

For the sake of consistency I always follow the same shave prep and lather routine when testing: I wash my face twice with a Van der Hagen glycerin soap. I then apply Maggard Pre-Shave Oil (orange scent). I lather up using a 26mm Synthetic Stirling Soap shave brush. After the shave I wash my face with cold water and apply an alum block. I let this dry a little then rinse off, dry my face and apply some Thayers alcohol-free witch hazel.

Here is the extraordinary thing: Bought in bulk (100 plus at a time) the Rapira Platinum Lux is also the cheapest blade. I pay less than six cents per blade currently.

I live in Connecticut, USA, and don't work for the company that makes the Rapira line, nor do I currently sell them, so I have no bias!

title: Decent product, but deceiving packaging.
text:
As the eye cream on its own, Jeosisy's eye cream works pretty well. It lifts bags under your eyes within an hour and has results that last through the day. I didn't notice any permanent changes over time, but did appreciate a quick remedy to undereye bags from not sleeping enough. The product leaves a light white powdery residue behind that will need to be dusted off once it dries.

My bigger complaint with this product is the deceiving nature of the packaging. This is 1/2 ounce of product, but it comes in a huge jar container. As pictured, over half of the size of the packaging is the dispenser, not the actual container for the cream product itself. That just seems dishonest to me. Additionally, the dispenser is a goofy design that requires you to press down on the white disc to dispense the product. It's difficult to dispense an accurate amount, and any product that isn't completely cleared off of the disc will dry and clog up the dispenser.

Overall: The product works, but the dispenser is goofy and deceiving. Make sure you know what you're getting before you order.

title: I am a new fan!!! Love, love, love this straightener.
text:
Okay, this might be a long review but I hope it helps!
Back in the mid 2000’s, when the Chi was selling like hot pancakes, I had such a hard time finding one available, that one day I ended up buying a Paul Mitchell iron. I fell in love with it and never again tried to buy a Chi. After 13 years of using my PM, it finally started having issues with the electrical cord. My sweet husband, seeing how much I was struggling to flat iron my hair, got on Amazon and bought me this Titanium hair straightener. I didn’t want to stop using my Paul Mitchell (was kinda sentimental about it), but I finally put it away and gave this one a try... BEST decision ever!!!! I hadn’t realized how long it actually would take my old straightener to do the job. I though 20-30 minutes straightening my hair was normal. This titanium iron is the real deal. I have super long (almost to my waist), medium thickness hair. Not thin, not coarse... but if I don’t flat iron it, I look like a lion on a bad hair day. Very frizzy. This iron heats up so quickly and it goes up to 450F. I have seriously straightened my whole hair in less than 15 minutes. More like 10 minutes. A little more if I want to flip it and curl the ends. I seriously love this titanium straightener. And no, I didn’t get the product for free just to review it. Like I said, my husband did his homework researching and bought me this for my birthday.

The only thing that I would suggest is that you might have to wear a heat glove if you are using it to curl your hair, since the outside of the plates does get hot, and when you use it to curl, you have to grab the hot end.

Anyway.. I hope it last 13 years or more like my old straightener!

title: Very good for giving texture and body to heavy, thick hair
text:
I have tried all kinds of mousses, hair sprays, gels, you name it, to provide some texture and hold for my very thick, somewhat frizzy hair. Left to itself, my hair frizzes up into a kind of nondescript limp mess if just left to air dry. When blown dry, it looks good for half an hour and then it just flattens to my head, limp and without any shape. No amount of hair spray, mousse or gel has both given my hair texture AND kept it in place and natural-looking for more than an hour. This Exotic Argan Oil Texture Paste is very good at providing texture to my hair without looking greasy or leaving flakes or film. It is definitely the best thing I have ever used, and I am in my 50's and I think I've used everything out there.

One complaint I have though , I have to add several layers of it - first I dip my fingers in several times, getting enough to kind of coat the ends of my fingers, and then I run my fingers through my wet hair; then I blow it dry and again dip my fingers in several times to rub it all over the ends (to keep them separated and give them some body) and then I rub it through the fine hairs that stick up on top of my head. So this is quite the procedure, but in the end I am pretty happy with the result. It keeps its shape and is more textured than with any other product.

That said, I still have to spray hairspray all over to keep the style and "bounciness" from falling out. So I am giving it four stars because I wish I could just slap on a little of this and go. Perhaps there is a stronger hold than medium hold? But it's still nice to be able to get some body and hold into my heavy, thick hair.

title: Addictive combination of vanilla and aldehydes!
text: I bought a sample and immediately had to rush to get the full bottle! An incredible blend of aldlehydes and vanilla. I'm not normally much of a fan of aldehydes but, as soon as I tried this, it was love at first sniff. If you are wanting or expecting a more traditional bakery-type sweet vanilla (don't get me wrong - I love those kinds of vanillas), you won't find it here. However, if you are looking for something different, an interesting juxtaposition, you will find it here. I find the scent fairly linear (the scent doesn't change much over time), but I'm happy about that because then I get to keep smelling a luxuriously bubbly, elegant scent for hours. This smells much more expensive than it is. It smells rich - not in a heavy or thick way, but in the sense that it brings to mind someone who has great taste and appreciates quality. I'm truly delighted with Vanille Farfelue. I also highly recommend JD Duality - especially if you are looking for a scent with a more pronounced (although still complex and sophisticated) vanilla.

title: Tape In Extensions
text: I purchased the 18" and 22" tape in extensions (4P/27&2) and overall I am satisfied. The color shown on-line was the color I received, it was extremely accurate, the hair seemed a little bit sparse at the ends but it was fine, my stylist said they felt good and went in smoothly. My hair is pretty short but curling it all seems to help blend everything in. This is the first time I tried the tape-in's and I do really like them, they are very easy to sleep in which was one of my main concerns. Previously I had the microbeads and those drove me crazy. I thought the price was fair and they offered a large variety of color options which was part of the reason I ended up with these. I also did a lot of research before deciding on the tape-in's, it was helpful getting familiar with all the pro's and con's. I also purchased extra tape and adhesive remover so I had it on-hand in case these started to come out. So far I haven't had any pieces fall out or feel like they were loose and they seem easy to manage but I have only had these in less than a week and have only washed my hair once. Here are some semi-negative things that I am keeping my eye on but when I curled my hair there were several times it left black stuff on my curling iron and I was under the impression if it was human hair it wouldn't do that, so we will see how things go. The hair feels not as soft as I think it should so that bothers me a little bit especially since I have only had them in for such a short time. The last thing I noticed is that some of the pieces of hair are almost picky/itchy, which I found to be weird. I am not sure that I will purchase these again would like to try another brand so I have some better comparisons on which ones are best suited for me. But overall I am pretty happy with these.

The reason why I gave this product 4 stars instead of 5 was when I tried to remove the nail polish off is because when I try to remove it with nail polish remover, it actually takes a long time. You'll notice that when you wipe off the nail polish with a cotton ball dipped in nail polish remover, the top color layer comes off, but you are still left with a silver layer that is stuck to your nails. I have tried this with a few colors and no matter what color the nail polish is, when I try to remove it, I'm left with a silver layer on my nails that is hard to remove. You kind of have to press really hard with the cotton ball and put more remover for it to come off. I've never had an issue like this with any other nail polish I've used. And this nail polish wears away like other nail polishes I've used, so it's not like it lasts longer or anything. The only issue is that when I try to remove it with nail polish remover, it kind of takes awhile. But other than that, I really like this set and I definitely recommend it.

title: Gran afeitadora !!
text:
Tras 15 años de fieles y diarios servicios, decidí reemplazar mi antigua Philishave 715.

Luego de una pequeña investigación, me decidí por este modelo considerando que presenta un buen equilibrio entre precio y prestaciones.

PROS:

Produce una excelente afeitada en corto tiempo.
Es liviana, silenciosa y de fácil manejo.
Buena duración de la batería.
Puede usarse con o sin el cable de conexión eléctrica.

CONS:

Creo que el diseño del sistema de recarga debe pensarse mejor:

1) Tanto la plataforma como el mecanismo mediante el cual se apoya la máquina en dicha plataforma no parecen muy resistentes.

2) Para un funcionamiento más inteligente, la recarga debería funcionar automáticamente al detectar que la batería llega a un nivel bajo de carga. Así se podría tener la plataforma conectada permanentemente al enchufe y colocar siempre la afeitadora en su plataforma cuando no está en uso. Actualmente, y por sugerencia del fabricante, es el usuario el que debe administrar el proceso de recarga "cuando la batería esta cerca de agotarse".¡¡Solo que el equipo no tiene ningún indicador para saber el estado de carga de la bateria y, por lo general, simplemente nos enteramos porque la afeitadora se detiene en medio de una afeitada !!

title: No nicks, easy to use, easy to charge, quiet...
text:
This razor is nice to look at, easy to hold, feels good, and isn't too loud. It does a good job on some hair and not on others. Summary: works on hair that isn't too long and isn't too short, incredibly well.

I first tried this when I was about 2 days out from having shaved my legs. The razor did not remove most of the stubble - I think it's just to short. However, I have always struggled to shave the back of my thighs in the shower, and thus the hair there is longer and finer. This razor did a good job on that hair, though I had to go over it a few times from different directions - it definately cuts best when going against the grain, and the hair on the back of my thighs and underarms seems to grow at all different angles, so I had to shave from all different angles.

While I don't believe this can become my only razor, I am keeping it because a) it does well on longer, finer hair and is easier to use in areas I can't see well, like the back of my thighs. b) It does a good enough job that I'm keeping it for those times when I got lazy, didn't shave, not suddenly find myself going somewhere and needing a quick dry leg shave. If it just got those shorter hairs better, so I could use it every 2-3 days, I would love it.

As most people do, I generally deal with blemishes the old-fashioned way of picking and popping, which is unsanitary and leaves my skim looking even worse for a while. This is my first time owning tools that help with extractions, though I have had them used on me when getting a facial.

I will be continuing to try and see if I have greater success.

This set seems to be useful, though the case is not quality. I decided to store them with some other beauty tools in a mason jar on my counter instead. I spray with rubbing alcohol before using to keep things sanitary.

If you're looking for extraction tools for blemishes, it would probably be worth your while to give these a try. They're not too expensive and will likely save your skin from trauma.

title: Great razor, used for years now, durable enough
text:
I have used the norelco wet/dry shaver for over 6 years now. I first used it in Iraq, it was a Godsend. Yes, it obviously takes longer to shave than with a regular razor to get a good shave, but shaving everyday with a regular razor destroys my face. Once you get used to this razor, I assure you you will practically look forward to shaving. I have found that using a face cleanser (like Phisoderm or others) along with the moisturizer you load in the razor make the shave much nicer. I am overseas again in support of Afghanistan and travel all over the place. This razor holds up during my travels with no issues. It is more durable than you think. 1 charge lasts about 5/6 days, depending on how long you take to shave. They are not expensive, so I own two of them to ensure I always have one charged.

Again, great razor and highly recommended.

LTC John K

title: Nice, light moisturizer
text:
When I first tried this serum, I wasn't sure I liked it...but it has grown on me. The serum is well-described as being milky. It's thin and white...so much so that I found it hard to believe it could be much of a moisturizer. And when I put it on my face, I noticed it had a bit of a tack/stickiness to it. It wasn't overwhelming like glue, but if I put my hands to my face, I noticed that tacky feeling. Again, these were not things I was used to in a moisturizer.

The moisturizer is fairly quickly absorbed; however, and that tackiness goes away within a minute or so. What you're left with is a nice smooth feeling. I don’t know that my face feels overly moisturized, but it feels healthy. I also tested it on one of my elbows (which has just a bit of eczema), and I believe the eczema has improved beyond what it was looking like with shea butter applications alone.

My wife has been using this serum as well, and she would give it 3 or 4 stars...while my opinion is 4 or 5. Four stars then seems fair. I love that this serum has its origins in Korea, as I trust their beauty standards. And admittedly I would say my feeling that the serum was a bit unusual was tempered by the product's origins. Again, I trust their beauty standards and somewhat assume I'm filling a hole I didn't know was there. A couple weeks in, I'm not yet completely convinced that I will make this or a similar product a standard in my skin care regimen. I nevertheless love the idea of rotating products/varying what you apply to your skin (to again cover any holes the products you've been using may be missing), so I'm very glad I tried it. If I notice any outstanding results (one way or another), I will provide an update.

title: Bio Silk conditioner is a superior detangler.
text:
Bio Silk conditioner is a superior detangler. For those with long hair, you know how hard it is to find any detangler that works well and does not leave your hair weighted-down or dull. I use both the Bio Silk shampoo and conditioner and appreciate the fact that it actually restores the texture and appearance of my hair. Even if I use a different shampoo or don’t feel the need to condition, I prefer to finish with a pumpful of Bio Silk at the ends of my hair to ease my comb-out. It tames my damp-weather Pacific Northwest frizz and I imagine it would work as well on curly hair I find both the shampoo and conditioner to be surprisingly gentle on my scalp.
There is an issue with the fragrance: upon opening it does have a strong smell (for me, it’s a 1950’s salon smell) not exactly unpleasant, but distinct. Well, the good news is that the smell dissipates in a couple of weeks (oxygen-exchange?) and mellows into a citrus/woodsy scent (as opposed to a floral.)
For those who want to rejuvenate coarse, tangled, dull hair, I can recommend both the Bio Silk shampoo and conditioner. I was really pleased that it solved some of my more vital hair problems and was free of parabens and sulfates!

title: Great Until the Setting Slips!
text:
I scoured the net looking for the perfect beard trimmer to trim my beard that I brough back from Iraq. I didn't want to look like a terrorist, so I needed a trimmer to keep my beard looking civilized. I read the reviews here and was prepared for a somewhat weak vacuum- even on turbo. No big deal- I wanted results, and the vacuum was just a perk anyway. It caught maybe half the hair on turbo, so whoopie.

Well, I should have paid more attention to the negative reviews! I was careful not to hold the trimmer by the click wheel to avoid accidentally going down a setting... I did that once and clicked from a 5 to a 4. I liked the 4 better anyway, so stuck with that. I happily trimmed to a 4 once a week (sometimes twice to clean it up) for the last couple months and it worked well, until just a couple of days ago when the setting slipped all the way down to 1 when I was in the middle of shaving! I went from a nice beard to the 5 o-clock shadow look! I AM FURIOUS!

There needs to be some sort of setting lock that prevents it from just slipping and ruining your beard! How hard would that be? Just build the dial with a notch you can slide a bar into in order to lock it!

Until they build this with a locking device, avoid it, or you could lose your hard-earned beard- just like I did!

title: Interesting product, smells great!
text:
This is an interesting product. First, I love the way it smells! I purchased it solely to use as a shampoo. I have shoulder length very thick and curly hair. I generally blow it out and wash it only every other day. I blow it out because my curls tend to be frizzy so I am always looking for a product that will let me go natural some days but not be frizzy. That said, I have not yet gone with my natural curl when using this product. But I can offer some things I have noticed thus far.

First, this bar does not lather, which frankly makes it difficult to spread around on ones hair. I spend a lot of time in the shower trying to rub the bar all over my hair as much as I can. I will say I think my hair is clean, or at least doesn't feel dirty to me. When you rinse, be aware that your hair will feel like you just poured hot wax all over it and then tried to rinse it off with cold water. It feels very sticky and odd and that won't change no matter how long you rinse. I still use a conditioner after to limit the tangles. Typically after washing I would put in a serum or oil before I blow out. I did that after I used this bar the first time and quickly realized that was a mistake. It left my hair feeling far too greasy. This shampoo bar already leaves my hair feeling heavier and thicker as it is, slightly waxy maybe (but not in an intolerable way). Though I don't feel like I am experiencing a build up of product or anything using this shampoo bar, I do find myself using regular shampoo at least once a week just to feel like I'm getting a good scalp scrub in and to lighten the feel and texture of my hair. It's hard to explain the difference in how my hair feels with the bar vs shampoo other than to say the bar leaves it heavier, harder to run my hands thru, but someone just looking at me wouldn't be able to tell that. It looks like it always has, doesn't look greasy or anything, but feels much different to the touch. I will plan on going with my natural curl more during the summer and will see how it affects that look and feel.

Update 6-18

So I have used this many times now leaving my hair to dry naturally and curly. It definitely makes my curls less frizzy. What I am having an issue with is feeling like I get my scalp clean. With no lather it is impossible to get this product all the way into my scalp so I have to use a traditional shampoo at least once a week. I live in Phx, it's hot, so I can't have a sweaty head. It gets itchy.

title: Removed dark Magenta! Works!
text:
I have natural dark brown hair with deep tones of red. I've been blonde for a few years with a pixie cut, but am growing out, so used a demi brown which worked great. When I went to saloon for a trim/shape we decided to color, and I wanted an auburn which is a natural brown with red tones. I specifically said, no magenta. $200 later I walked out with a deep red permanent magenta. :/ Lived with it a few days and still saw pink. Hated it.

First, I tried to tone it down with non-permanent ash. Didn't do much. I used another product called Vanish, which did remove some of the brightness but I felt it was a bit strong to do again. Tried Salerm after researching and watching another girl on YouTube with bright magenta have success. Hers went very orange and she did it twice to lift it out and had to add another filler color. I did a test strip, then used for only 15 minutes instead of 20. It stripped all the pink out and left the pretty auburn brown tones blending to my natural. FINALLY! I would do a test, but I do recommend this product. I applied and left a good conditioner in for 30 min after as well, but it didn't damage hair at all. I never leave huge reviews, but it worked and I'm so grateful!

The T980 works very well for a consumer-grade device. The batteries last much longer than necessary (at least, in the first few months of ownership) but using the trimmer corded isn't a problem. And it's a snap to use.

There are a couple things you should know. First, the highest setting is about 3/4" so if you want parts of your beard longer, you won't have the automatic height setting available. title: The first Goodys Brushes I bought are twenty-three years old. These brushes should last as long due to the same design.
text:
The color was different (blue with black bristles) and the bristles feel a little "sharper" than my 20 year old cream colored Goodys Brushes. I was looking for a Goodys Brush For my son because he likes mine so much. (We both have longer hair than his mom) These brushes are the best brush for guys with long hair. The design prevents any "catching" as you brush out knots. Brushes with little "balls" on the tips of the bristles, get caught in knots. Then the little balls pull off leaving uncomfortably sharp bristle tips.

The "Original" Goodys Brushes I have, have lasted since 1993. I have two large ones and a number of miniatures. Their design, one of simplicity, has allowed the to last 23 years with only minor bristle breakage. The bristles are wider at the base and tips than the newer brushes; and the bristle tips are rounder than the newer bristles. The new bristles are black in color, compared to the opaque bristles of the original. Not being sure about the composition of the bristles; I am unable to tell you if they will last as long as the originals.

All in all; my son is very pleased to have his own Goodys Brushes which are distinguishable from mine. Hopefully we will get twenty years out of the new ones. If nothing else; the price is right if you buy in bulk. Six of these should, barring loss, last a lifetime.

title: Very close and comfortable shave
text:
I'm almost 50 and have been using an electric razor most of my shaving life. When my trusty Norelco needed replacing, my wife bought me the latest self-cleaning Braun for a Christmas gift. I liked some aspects of it, but it always had a hard time shaving my neck area without going back over it a lot of times. Replacing the cutter and screen every 6 months or so helped keep it from getting progressively worse, but after a couple of years, I thought I would try something different.

I read MANY reviews and decided to try the Norelco Spectra system. I've been using it for several months now and I can tell you the difference on my neck is like night and day. The Norelco is MUCH faster and smoother than the Braun and cuts very close after only a couple of passes. I was amazed at how much better it was than even my old triple-head Norelco.

If I were to have ANY negative, it would be the charging system. The first problem is, if you provide a recharging "stand", then the logic (IMO) should be that the stand be allowed to be plugged in 24/7 with the razor in it, without any adverse affects. However, MANY places in the manual tell you DOING THIS WILL SHORTEN THE LIFE OF YOUR BATTERY.

Because they use a NiCad battery, they ask that you only recharge it when it runs low to avoid the "memory" effect and associated diminished capacity. I can understand that, but the second problem is, it gets fully charged in only 4 hours! After that, you are supposed to remove it from, or unplug, the stand to avoid overcharging. Unfortunately, most of us shave in the morning before a work day, then don't return for at least 9-10 hours. In my case, a 12 or even 24 hour charge would be far more convenient. What's so hot about a "4-hour charge" anyway?? OK, how about I push a button to start the charge cycle, and it automatically shuts off when fully charged! How easy is that? (Gee, that's exactly how my Braun worked.)

Being an Electrical Engineer myself, I'm sometimes overly critical of things like this. OK, if it were me, (are you listening Norelco???) I would have used a NiMH battery that didn't have to be "deep cycled", then use a lower current "trickle charge" base that could be left on 24/7. A side benefit is when you pack for a trip and grab your razor, you KNOW it's always 100% charged and will probably have enough juice to last the entire trip without dragging the charger along.

OK, maybe the charger is not as bad as I make it out to be. I just think it could be better. I give it 3 stars, while the razor itself gets a full 5 stars.

If you are shaving your back with a full crop of hair, it isnt going to work very well, just like trying to shave your face or wherever without trimming things down first. If you are really hairy you will need to either nair anyway or be very very very patient with this thing as it will only shave about a square inch of long hair on its own. Seems like it will be good to use if your hair is very short though. 2. The plastic slot that you put the razor in could be designed better. It is basically a softer plastic tube that grips the handle of a normal disposable razor inside the harder plastic body of the Razorba. This could be improved by putting some sort of screw clamp on the side so your disposable couldnt move. I think this could be done without increasing the cost much since I suspect they make a pretty huge profit margin on these things. The problem with the razor not being held securely is that it can turn slightly in the plastic sleave and cut you, this doesnt really hurt but if you are a bleeder its hard to get it to stop. Another thing that could be improved is to make a hole in the end of the head of the thing opposite where you put the razor for water to flow out of. After you rinse off the razorblade water collects in the head which when you go to do another stroke flies all over your bathroom, but more seriously makes the razor fit less tightly in the soft plastic tube. All in all this product does work but their are a few minor annoyance type issues that coule be fixed easily to make it better.

title: caveat emptor
text:
This machine is all right if you like to shave three times a day. Otherwise, stick with your blade.

The famous pivoting heads do not actually pivot much, so upper neck, jaw and chin are a real challenge to trim. And two hours later, you feel like you need a shave.

Also, the elaborate cleaning/oiling recommended by the User's Manual will have you longing for the simplicity of your razor.

Further, the cost of replacing heads is a hidden cost. Also, the need to purchase the oil and cleaning supplies. They do not come with the machine.

Finally, the User's Manual (even though labeled 9160 XL) does not square with the machine supplied.

Bottom line: If you're thinking of switching from razors to electric shavers, think again.

It's unfortunate the manufacturer put so much perfume in an item targeted at those with skin conditions. This should have been fragrance-free or nearly fragrance free (maybe a very light citrus). I would personally recommend they remove the perfume and re-release this product as fragrance free aside from the natural scent of olive oil and goat milk. The ingredients list is very simple and the product has a lot of promise.

title: Not "luxurious" and way overpriced for its level of cleaning performance
text:
Apparently my definition of "luxury" differs substantially from the product creator. Even on a poofie, it takes quite a few pumps to make enough lather to shower with.

The scent didn't win me over. It's kind of a non-descript muddle of essential oils. I use essential oils myself and love tea tree, rosemary, lavender, peppermint, etc. This smells like I just threw a drop of each in my hand and mixed them together. There is no layering of fragrance notes.

In regards to moisturizing, it left my skin dry. I normally shower daily with [[ASIN:B010MKCM4Y Old Spice Dry Skin Defense Body Wash + Double Impact 16 Oz (Pack Of 2)]] and it keeps my skin moist enough to not have to use lotion when I get out of the shower. Today I showered with Graydon All-Over-Soap at 11am and had to put lotion on by noon.

For my face, I currently use and I'll stick to [[ASIN:B001CMV8FG Desert Essence Thoroughly Clean Face Wash Refill, 32-Ounce]]. Just a couple drops of the Desert Essence product is all I need to wash my face. With this Graydon product, I felt like I needed at least a full pump, maybe 2.

At roughly $22 for 8 ounces, I expected better. This is a definite no.

title: EXPENSIVE BUT VERY EFFECTIVE. YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE GETTING.
text: This review is for the ANCIENT MINERALS "GOODNIGHT' MAGNESIUM LOTION WITH MELATONIN. An excellent product to help you get to sleep faster. You just use one press of the pump to release the amount of product and then spread it on your skin. I put some on my temples and the rest on the inside of my arms. It is absorbed fairly quickly and does its job quickly, too. It helps me to get to sleep faster (nothing works all the time) and is a very effective product, easy to use and not messy. I find it superior to the MELATONIN SLEEP CREAM, which is also a very good product, but this seems to be more potent and works faster. It is also very much more expensive. You get 2.5 oz. (75ml) in one container. This, of course, contains magnesium which also helps sleeping, and the manufacturer states clearly that each full pumpful delivers 25mg of elemental magnesium along with 3mg of melatonin. I appreciate their specifying exactly what you are getting. Since each pumpful delivers 1 ml of product, this container should deliver 75 dosages of product. Unfortunately, MELATONIN SLEEP CREAM does not specify the amount of active ingredient you are getting, which I failed to mention in my review of it, although the jar contains 4 oz. of product. So, there is no way to know how much melatonin you are getting since the product is not metered and the label doesn't tell you the melatonin content. Both are good products, but I cannot compare dosages or contents of product delivered when you apply them. The only reason I didn't give it five stars is because of the expensiveness of the product.

title: Emilie Heathe’s Lipstick…fabulous and beautiful!
text:
Emilie Heathe’s Lipstick in Public/Shimmering Burnt orange is fabulous! This lipstick gives me the right “pop” of color I have been looking for and has beautiful little sparkles in it, making it perfect for both daytime and night time (or even special occasion use!) There is so much to love about this lipstick!

1. This lipstick glides on easily, is moisturizing, and really complements my fair/ivory (with pink undertones) skin color.
2. It feels creamy and luxurious, while not feeling heavy, and feels perfectly natural on my lips no matter how long I was wearing it. It did not look orange on me, considering the name (shimmering burnt orange), but was a very pretty shade of medium peach. Love it!
3. The packaging for the lipstick is extremely chic, being black and sleek. The lipstick tube has a lid that “locks” together with the base, making me feel like the lid is more secure in my purse than a conventional lid. I have not used a lipstick with this kind of packaging before, and it is a nice detail. It is all about the details!
4. The icing on the cake is that this lipstick is vegan, cruelty-free, made in the U.S.A, and packaging is recyclable and sustainably so you can feel good about using this product in so many ways!

Hope you get a chance to love this great lipstick by Emilie Heathe, as I much as I do!

title: This Is one of the nicer ones Ive tried, But pricey.
text:
I have tried several of these over the past few months and while this is easily the best one, I personally don't think it is worth the 3 bills they are asking.

the retail packaging on this is fantastic and the hard shell box it comes in is a big bonus, but as far as the device itself it seems to be on par with some half this price. I personally would rather received it in a plain box to save a little money. The one little thing that Is super convenient that stands out is this has the proper size cable ties already on it and they're not Velcro! They are button snaps and that is a great thing because the Velcro ties get full of hair and fuzz.

And Like similar devices with the the cold touch thing it is a little weird the first time you feel it. because you think it feels warm but it's not, it just messes with your head a bit. And so far with this feature you can't really feel this one doing anything until you get a little overlap in the same session. So that is nice.

And with this one I have noticed some results.
I have been testing these on different small sections of my leg in the same area trying to get a consistent controlled test and I'm keeping track of how long it takes. I'm a big Burley guy so there's no shortage of hair on my legs. lol
So with this one after about 4 weeks using it twice a week I do see the hair thinning out a bit. But a couple devices half this price did the same thing. And it is definitely heating the hair. To make sure I tried it on an unshaved area and it definitely stings a little as the fully exposed hairs heat up. But, a couple others did this as well.

So is it worth it for you? Maybe. if you want a premium feel and look with everything like you bought it at Neiman Marcus, buy this one.
But if you just want hair removal and don't care about the packaging there are cheaper options available.

title: It works as I expected.
text:
When my old beard trimmer conked out after a half dozen years, I wanted a nice new one. Not the clunker my wife had purchased for me six years ago that pulled hairs, kept my sink a mess, and looked cheap. So I typed in Google, "What is the best beard trimmer?" On two of three sites I checked, the Philips Norelco T980 Turbo Vacuum Trimmer was tops.

What sold me, was the video of one reviewer actually using the trimmer and explaining all of its functions and how to use it. As an aside, the Amazon reviews were helpful as well - so when I was shaving and turned the trimmer on its side, I was not surprised when hairs fell out of the vaccum trap.

That being said, the beard trimmer worked just as I had hoped. I look forward to taking time out once a week to trim my beard. The guard feels good against my skin and the hairs are all evenly cut. I haven't had a pulled hair yet. The shaper works well, giving nice clean lines. And the vaccum works great with the beard trimmer and guard - 99% of hair winds up in the vaccum chamber. The pieces are easy to clean and adjust.

Negatives and these are minor andonly have to do with the vaccum. Mind you, if there was no vaccum my sink would be filled with black hairs, so having any type of vaccum is great. The negatives are: 1. if you turn your hand too far over, the hairs will start to spill out - that's happened twice in the eight times I've used it so far. And it was only a little. 2. The vaccuum is realitively useless with the shaper as other reviewers have mentioned.

One other thing, where the beard meets my hairline just above the ear, I've found the guard obstructs the view a bit so it's hard to see where to stop. It's probably just a thing of practice and the length of my beard, but I figured I'd let everyone know where I find myself taking a little bit of time when shaving.

Definately a good buy. I look forward to beard trimming day.

title: These work so well and are super strong. I've tried a bunch of nail strips ...
text: These work so well and are super strong.I've tried a bunch of nail strips and these are by far my favorite. I would recommend going slow, especially if it's your first time applying nail wraps. The secret is to lightly buff the top of your nail to give the wrap something with texture to adhere to. Then, wash your hands throughly and wipe your nails down with an alcohol pad to get any excess natural oil off of them. This will also help it stick longer because oil will break down the adhesive. Then, start at the base of your nail and slowly apply, pulling only slightly enough for the strip to remain taut. When you get to the end of your nail, pinch the strip together so it wraps around the edges and push over and under the edge slightly so it's wrapped the front completely as well. Use your finger to smooth out any wrinkles (usually it's very few, if any), then lightly and slowly file off the excess in a downward motion instead of a side to side motion. Hit with the blow dryer for a few seconds and you're good to go! I gave nails that last 14+ days doing it this way, and the incoco ones are seriously great for it.

title: Impressive ship speed, simple & easy product assembly, sturdy seat, comfort & cushion level of seat is ok -below average
text:
Impressive shipping speed- Product was delivered promptly and I received it today (within 3 days of order)- shipped out of a local warehouse near King County, WA. (Thank you shipper). I ordered this for my small office that did not have space for a full chair and I needed to adjust seating based on varying table height so I wouldn't have to adjust my patient treatment table every day after my office partner uses it. This chair hopefully was also intended to slide out of the way under the table. (This is yet to be seen).
Packaging was simple and in a nice sturdy cardboard box with built in sturdy handles- a plus. Unpacking was easy and there were 4 pieces included in the box all of which were bubble wrapped except for the base and seat pieces. The easiest assembly I have gone through and took me all of 5-7 minutes. There was no shipping record or paperwork and the assembly instructions were almost non-existent except for a single sheet of paper with a picture of all the components shipped.
The first thing that struck me was how wide and large the saddle seat was so this is a great purchase for those who are wider in the seat. Roughly measures about 17" wide and 16" long from rear of seat to the saddle tip. the leather on the stool looks great and is nailed with a few staples on the underside. The construction on this is average and attention to detail was missed. Again a small move that would have raised this rating to much higher.
The picture enclosed wasn't very clear with the plastic piece in the round foot rest component. I had to figure this piece out. Everything else just snaps in as displayed in the order shown. Tighten the foot rest plate so that it is stable. I sat on the seat for about 10 minutes and it was not a comfortable experience for my tail bone. I will have to pad this seat even further with a towel or a blanket perhaps. They indicate a 3" cushion which I do not think is hardly sufficient. I am not used to a saddle seat and it feels like you are straddling a seat between your legs with a small hump in front of you. I opted this for the footprint of the stool, cushion, comfort, swivel and the ability to support lower-back issues.
If the seat comfort was slightly more comfortable and cushioned by at least another 2-3" I would have given this product 4 or 5 stars. Will update after 1-2 months of use.

title: Heat sensitive
text:
These stickers are beautiful! They do look fantastic on your nails! However the term sticker is really applicable. I had a lot of difficulty attaching them to my nails primarily because I don't grow mine out very long so I had to do a lot of cutting to get them to fit. It is rather unwieldy if you have short nails. I didn't deduct any stars for that though because that's a personal preference. I deducted one star because when I got out of the shower about 2 hours after application, the stickers had bunched up on 2 of my nails even though I had applied a top coat and given ample time to dry. The 2nd star was taken off the next day. I went swimming in hot weather and one peeled about half off my nail and I had 2 more nails get wrinkly under the heat and wet environment. However, the application I did on my toes turned out much better. Only one nail chipped and the rest look completely fine. It appears that if you're going to expose your nails to hot environments and activity (such as a shower or hot weather) then they don't hold up well.

If you'd like Nail Stickers that you don't need to heat up to apply, I'd recommend[[ASIN:B00RUEF0CM Tattify Rock And Roll Nail Wraps - Hollywood Rockabilly (Set of 22)]] . I've only had them on for a day so far, but they've held up very well.

title: Love this stuff!!!!!!!
text:
Ordered it and received it within 3 days. I've never tried Shea butter before but I had heard about it from friends, so thought I'd give it a try. So glad I did! I chose this one because of the free recipe book, which was really cool and easy to follow.

It's real smooth and creamy right out of the package. I just broke a chunk off and smoothed it on. I liked the earthy smell, but I also noticed that there was absolutely no smell 5 minutes after I rubbed it on. It only took a few minutes to soak into my skin and felt wonderful.

Melting it was so easy. I brought a small pot of water to a boil, turned off the heat, put a chunk of the Shea butter in a glass bowl and placed it over the pot of hot water (like a double boiler.) Fifteen minutes later it was perfectly melted.

After melting, I let it sit overnight on the counter. Next morning it was ready to be whipped and it whipped up perfectly! I did not need to put it in the fridge like the book said to get it to set up.

I added some stuff to it while I was whipping it up - a few ounces of olive oil... then I folded in some essential oil (I used tea tree oil). Made it smell yummy! I then put my concoction in a jar with a tight fitting lid... and it's right on my bathroom counter so I can use it every day!

This was so easy and fun to put together... and no chemicals or other unnecessary stuff on my skin! Woo hoo!!!!

title: No damage!
text:
I’ve used these for 2 manicures now. I use plastic “press on” type nails that come without adhesive so I use Beauty Secrets Drip proof Clog proof vegan nail glue.

I apply the nail guards to clean nails before glueing on the plastic nails. They’re easy to apply and file off the extra from the free edge. This one comes with 3 sheets of nails so it’ll last for about 3-4 manicures. I do my nails about 1 time a week. There was no need for me to buff my nails before applying these which is why I wanted them for my manicures. Buffing removes a layer of your nail bed = damaging your nails = no bueno.

To take these off, I soak my fingers in melted coconut oil. I don’t use nail polish remover or acetone because I’m lazy af and I like to reuse the plastic nails so I don’t have to bother with shaping and painting them again.

Just a word of caution: don’t be too agressive when removing these or you’ll cause damage to your real nails. If you have a long free edge, especially don’t lift your press one/acrylics from the back and bend your nail horizontally across the nail bed. I did that and ended up getting rips in the sides of my nails.

Also, don’t try to just rip the nails off if they aren’t loosening on their own, you’ll end up ripping off a top layer of your nail bed, leaving white patches and weak nails. Put the nails back into your oil/acetone/whatever and try again in a few minutes. You do have to be patient but I will say it’s a lot faster than trying to soak off gel or acrylics without nail guards.

I will definelty purchase these again but next time I’ll be buying the “pro pack” which has 720 instead of 54. Love these products! They give me a great manicure at home and while they can seem expensive, it’s still cheaper (and less damaging!) than going to the salon every week.

title: Beautiful, Gentle Cream - So Simple & So Nice - Great For Dry Skin & Sensitive Skin
text:
(Ingredients list is at the bottom of this review.)

I am really loving the TINAZANA Vegan Bakuchiol Comforting Cream (2.7oz / 80ml). Only 9 ingredients. It is so good. Truly comforting and non-irritating. Even when my skin is already in an irritated state.

This is a beautifully thick, rich, white moisturizing cream. Yet, somehow it feels decently lightweight and comfortable on the face and neck. Not lightweight like a gel cream, by any means. But comfortable. This cream glides onto the face and neck smoothly, and it soaks into the skin quickly; But it doesn't disappear. It leaves a lasting, soothing, comforting layer of moisture and hydration on the surface of the skin. It helps to lock-in the moisture and hydration from the previous steps in my skincare routine, and leave my skin feeling so lovely and comfortable.

The scent is extremely slight. It is herbal, but it's almost undetectable, unless you're really seeking after the scent.

The packaging is a beautiful yellow glass jar with a beige twist-off lid. It feels very nice in the hand, and the cream feels luxurious on the face. Much more expensive than it is. The 80ml size is excellent for the price.

The addition of gentle, anti-aging Bakuchiol is also a big win with zero irritation. Plus, Shea Butter for maximum moisture. I layer gentle, hydrating, soothing, calming toners and serums underneath this cream, and I get excellent glowy, dewy results.

I use this cream day and night, as I have dry, sensitive skin. I imagine many skin types might like this for day or night, especially during colder months.

If you have sensitive skin, and you cannot use most skincare products (like me), this is likely going to be for you.

Overall, I'm highly impressed. Why did it take me so long to find this? This cream is so beautifully simple. It's truly an amazing find for someone like me, who struggles with sensitive skin. I will definitely repurchase, and I'm looking forward to trying more simple, gentle products from Tinazana.

I highly recommend this cream to anyone and everyone.

INGREDIENTS:

Water, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Butylene Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Polysilicone-34, Isononyl Isononanoate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Ethyhexylglycerin, Bakuchiol.

title: Lovely, Glossy, Buttery Lip Balm That Lasts On The Lips
text:
(Ingredients list is at the bottom of this review.)

I'm so glad I ordered the Frankies Bikinis Lip Butter Gloss in Lilikoi. It's a really nice, smooth, emollient, buttery lip gloss/balm with decent staying power. It lasts on the lips, and doesn't require too frequent re-application. It also has a comfortable, smooth slip to it, and it is not sticky. The balm is yellow, but it goes on sheer. It doesn't look tinted on the lips.

The flavor is lilikoi, which is apparently another way of saying passion fruit. I'm not usually keen on passion fruit flavor, but this one is surprisingly nice. The flavor/scent is sweet and pleasantly fruity. Like a sweet, very lightly floral-perfumed fruit. It's really nice, and not at all off-putting or overpowering.

The packaging is excellent. The graphics and colors are beautiful. I also really like how the applicator is dome-shaped, with no sharp edges or openings to damage the lips. It makes it very easy to squeeze out the lip balm and apply it quickly. The formula and applicator also makes it difficult to squeeze out more than you intended, and that's important. I have found that feature lacking in some other lip products, and I've wasted a lot of product unnecessarily.

Overall, I'm really happy to have this lip gloss/balm, and I will continue using it. I'd highly recommend this to anyone looking for a nice glossy lip balm to try.

INGREDIENTS:

Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Rhus Verniciflua Peel Wax, Rhus Succedanea Fruit Wax, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Natural Flavor, Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Tribehenin, Sorbitan Isostearate, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Tocopherol, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax, Theobroma Cacao (Cocoa) Seed Butter, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Borago Officinalis (Borage) Seed Oil, Hippophae Rhamnoides (Sea Buckthorn) Fruit Oil, Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Oil, Monoammonium Glycyrrhizinate, Mica, Titanium Dioxide, Carmine, Tin Oxide.

title: Myconos Long Lasting Multi BB Cushion 💧
text:
This is my first BB Cushion Compact.
I've had great experiences with Myconos products n the past so decided to try this out to for that full - Bang effect.

But, I decided to purchase this because I've read from other reviewers with oily skin that it didn't cause a hindrance for them- using this.

title: No More Hacked Cuticles!
text:
I was in desperate need to replace my cuticle nippers, which had become quite dull and were actually making my cuticles look worse. A manicurist once told me that you could make belts out of my cuticles and I have NEVER had a manicure without the exclaimation of, 'You have very thick cuticles!' This should give you an idea of how important this tool is in my personal beauty kit. My current pair had been pricey and I just did not want to shell out that kind of money at the moment. I am an avid Amazon shopper and decided to see what was on the site. I came across this pair and the price was more than fair and the reviews were pretty stellar, with only one or so negative reviews.

Size - I feel that the size is universal and should fit most hands comfortably. I wear a woman's size 7 glove comfortably over jewelry and find that it fits both my palm and fingers perfectly. It is slim and easy to maneuver, even in spots of the nail bed that can be a bit tricky to get to.

Performance - It springs back automatically after each squeeze. The blade is sharp, but not so sharp that you practically amputate a digit. It is gentle, but effective. I wanted to use these nippers for at least a month to make sure the performance was consistent and it is. Sometimes we get a bit over zealous upon first use and then discover our purchase is not so great after all.

Price - The cost is more than fair. I have seen clippers in the drugstore that are more than 3 times this price. Also, Amazon has an excellent return policy.

Over all, I think that this pair of cuticle clippers is a perfect personal purchase and highly recommend trying a pair of you are in the market for a pair.

title: Hmmmmm....Yes For the Cost
text: I am straddling the fence on this product. I may be critiquing a bit harshly, considering that this is a drugstore product and the cost was minimum. On one hand this is a surprising little gem for a high end makeup lover, such as myself. Albeit, I expected the consistency to be a bit thicker, but it wears well without creasing and the applicator does not clog or get goopy as I expected. As a matter of fact, the thinner consistency became a bonus in the warmer months when I wear lighter textured foundation and less face powder. I cannot give it 5 stars, because the colors advertised in the photo is misleading. It shows 3 shades, but you actually receive 3 of the same shade. I ordered beige, but it is actually more of a pink shade. I mixed in a couple shades of foundation and it became a usable shade. Again, for the cost, this did not present a major problem. However, if the pack contained 3 shades as shown, the buyer would be able to create their own shade of concealer. Had I not had a few sample shades of foundation that I otherwise would not be able to use, the product would have been a waste. I paid just shy of $10 for a package of three. Considering I typically pay $30 or so for concealer at Sephora, I really cannot complain about this product aside from the shade issue.

title: If you have flawless skin, this is for you. If not...
text:
I really wanted to love this. I bought the Opals palette and I love the colors and the amount of shimmer. However, I feel like it sits on top of the skin and is impossible to blend in. I will say I have taken to mixing a tiny bit (really, really mix!!!) into my foundation. It gives me a little glow that wears nicely. As a highlighter for just portions of the face, it’s a different story.

You need to use a VERY light hand if you’re going to be anywhere near daylight. I’ve certainly gotten compliments outside while wearing it.

But as soon as I go inside, it COMPLETELY disappears. I mean, it’s gone. There’s nothing. So I can either go nuts and look like a clown on the way to my car and look kinda glam in office, or look like I’m not wearing anything.

I’ve also found this wears poorly over foundation or moisturizer. I’ve tried it with multiple brands. It sticks on tops and makes it look like I have glittery fine lines a few hours into wear. If you are prone to a pimple or breakout, this will sit on top of any blemish, no matter how much concealer you started with.

For someone who doesn’t wear a lot of makeup, this palette has lasted a long time. I don’t think I will buy it again, though. I think it’s best for someone with NO ACNE AT ALL and NO WRINKLES OR FINE LINES. So if you’re a 20 year old model, enjoy! As a 30 year old with mild adult acne, I am not impressed.

title: Best and Best-Buy Electric available today
text:
In spite of the fine reviews, when I ordered it I was skeptical. I'm a believer now. I also am always skittish when I hear of a product that tells you "time to buy more".. :)

Also the purchase of replacement heads CAN be reasonably priced IF you buy it from amazon rather than a vendor that needs added shipping AND you plan ahead to fit it into another purchase so you get free shipping (or even possible discounts). They are currently priced about $15 for 3 and that seems reasonable. (or you may find them at a "store near you" at retail price which I would expect to be similar).

PRO:
*The DUAL CLEAN provides excellent cleaning.
*For those with small mouths or special needs there are other heads available for whitening, flossing, soft bristle, and single rotating
*The battery SEEMS to be pretty long-lasting (based on others, I've not had it long enough to judge)
*reasonably priced and available head replacements
*the built-in 2 minute timer is also a nice feature
*the charger is small and functional (too tall for most medicine cabinets..). The cord is plenty long.
*Its easily rinsed

CON:
*The rechargeble battery SHOULD be specially disposed of (think green)
*The dual head is fairly large.. its fine for me, but for children or small mouths I expect it would be uncomfortable (use a different head style)
*The "buy now" color-change bristle seems to vary only with time, not use or bristle flexibility.. It is pretty much just a marketing gimmick.. buy a new one when you think you need it instead.

I've examined a number of electric brushes (and have owned a number over the last 30 years) and I believe this to truly be the best on the market to date.

edit 7/'11: The price on this has gone up almost $12! This is a 66% increase in a year.. There has been no retooling cost .. they are just milking a cash cow now.. I still like the unit, but the price is getting out of hand... no longer a "best buy" from me... it still is a very simple device. The replacement heads are now about $6 each.. up about 20%.

text:
Grand Parfums Versace Eros opens with a strong projection of citrus, fruity, sweet, musky and spicy notes. The opening is very fresh, sharp, bright, inviting, unique, and delectable. The green apple, mint, ambroxan, and lemon are the most prominent opening notes. The lemon is the fresh and bright opening note, astringent, sour, and vibrant; the green apple is by its side, delectable, sweet, sour, crispy, and acidic. The mint rounds up the opening with its cooling green and slightly spicy note. The ambroxan is also noticeable musky, lemony, and ambery note that works well, improving the fragrance's projection. As the fragrance moves towards its dry down, the tonka bean and vanilla add a sweet and aromatic touch without making the fragrance overly sweet or taking the focus away from the mint, green apple, and lemon. The vetiver, oakmoss, and cedar are part of the support notes; they combine their notes to create a fresh green and woody accord but remain in the back of the fragrance. The fragrance is linear, all notes come up as soon as the fragrance is applied and continue into the dry down. Once Grand Parfums Versace Eros has reached its full dry down, it can be summarized as a strong projection, spicy mint, fruity green apple, musky ambroxan, mildly sweet vanilla, tonka, and woody cedar fragrance. The fragrance feels casual, comforting, delectable, energizing, exquisite, fresh, fruity, green, high-quality, inviting, masculine, modern, musky, nicely-blended, playful, refreshing, rich, sharp, seductive, sour, sparkly, special, sweet, unique, versatile, wild, woody, and very pleasant.

SEASONS: Winter, spring, summer, fall, colder days, daytime, nighttime, and climate-controlled environments.
OCCASIONS: Outdoor gatherings, gym, sports, office, casual, holidays, vacations, romantic, dating, clubbing. This is an office-friendly fragrance.

title: I'll never go without it again!
text:
I'm a bigger girl, size 42DD for reference. I've started walking at least 2.5 miles a day wearing a weighted vest. Even in cool weather, with all the hills in my neighborhood, I end up drenched in sweat.

And that means, of course, boob sweat. I have ruined multiple bras and the smell is so gross. Since adding the vest, it's gotten so much worse. It's absolutely disgusting until I get a chance to shower. But I'm a busy mom of two special needs kids, so there are days I get back and can't shower right away, so then I'm feeling gross until I can.

I finally had enough and started looking for a solution. I found this stuff and figured I'd give it a shot. I was realistic in my expectations that it would help a bit, maybe even just help the smell, since is a strenuous activity and not a stroll through a grocery store. I wasn't expecting it to keep me from sweating at all or anything.

I tried it out for the first time today and it blew my expectations out of the water! I was slightly damp, but not even enough to drip. No smell. My bra was almost completely dry! And it's lasted ALL DAY.

I'm one of those ladies who hate wearing a bra at home, but hate how the girls rub without fabric there. I usually tuck whatever shirt I'm wearing under there. But that means that if I end up sweating for some reason, my shirt ends up wet and gross. Today, I realized that after taking off my bra, I wasn't bothered by the skin on skin. The lotion leaves a silky softness on the skin and it kept me comfortable all day.

Now on to the description. The bottle is smaller than I expected, but I learned that a little goes a long way. The lotion goes on creamy and dries quickly. It left no residue on my clothing or any I could see on my skin, except for on my hand from where I applied it. It rinsed off easily. The smell is supposed to be lily, according to the bottle, and I guess it kinda does smell like lily, though the product description listed apple in one place, so I dunno. But it's not a strong scent and it completely disappeared after application.

I love this product. I'm going to be a habitual user from now on and I'm recommending it to all my lady friends!

title: BBs are revolutionary, this makes it easy to find out why
text:
I had heard that BBs were the new rage but my brain was stuck on the need to match my skintone to the makeup, so I didn't feel comfortable buying it online if I couldn't see the color. Buying this kit helped me to realize that my hesitation over color was a silly concern. While it does look like foundation, it does not behave like foundation. I'm not sure what it uses to create the effect but I'm going to say that rather than pigment, it contains some sort of magical light diffuser. Up close, you cannot tell you are wearing any makeup. You can still see your sunspots and tone issues. However, step away from the mirror and suddenly they all disappear and your skin looks dewy and spot free. This is as revolutionary to makeup as Spanx was to the fashion world. You're wearing makeup but no one can tell. Brilliant!!!

Although the color is not something you need to worry about, the package does allow you to experiment with the different types of BBs that are out there. Some offer more coverage than others, some don't work as well with oily t-zones. I will definitely be purchasing a full size BB from this kit and am glad I took the risk to try the products. Additionally, the shipping from the seller was very fast. I ordered another sample kit from the Mischa (sp?) brand and it's been 2 weeks and I still haven't received it. It must be coming by boat from Korea and then will be walked to DC from the west coast, as it is not slated to arrive for another 2 weeks. Ridiculous!

I gave this hair 3 starts because it took color very well but it sheds so much it’s not even cool. Like I would run my finger through it and I have clumps of hair coming out in my hand. Luckily she only wanted it for her birthday so I’m okay but I like to give my customers quality work. My vendor has 613 wigs and it does not shed AT ALL so working with this hair was something I wasn’t used too. I had hair all in my sink all in my kitchen floor. I appreciate it because it came through when I needed it , but as far as 100% human hair, it’s not. I’ve been selling hair for a min.
